String.string: Get inspired by the Design Library base models to build your own solution to this project.

How can animals survive in their environment?
In this project, you will:

• Explore the different strategies animals use to catch their prey or to escape from their predators.
• Create and program a predator or prey in order to explore the relationship between them.
• Present and document your animal model, explaining the relationship between two species and how they are adapted to survive.
